classification: candidate formalization design; no source admission or world-truth proof

core.binding: Quantifiers introduce explicitly typed variables with lexical scope; capture-avoiding substitution required.
core.name: classical-many-sorted-first-order-static/v1-candidate

operator_meanings.equality: identity inside an explicitly shared carrier
operator_meanings.exists: body holds under at least one domain assignment
operator_meanings.forall: body holds under every domain assignment
operator_meanings.non-entailment: A separate countermodel query, not material implication or a core connective

empirical-probabilistic.status: extension contract required; observed support not proof of a universal law

finite-static.absence_ceiling: absence within those domains/interpretations only unless enumeration scope completeness is established
finite-static.interpretation: exact finite nonempty named domains and total symbol interpretations

inductive-fixed-point.entry: actual constructor/recursive meaning, least/greatest choice, well-foundedness or monotonicity conditions
inductive-fixed-point.status: extension contract required; not lowered by recursive iff alone

normative-deontic.entry: scope, norm subjects, permission/obligation/prohibition semantics and their selected model rules
normative-deontic.status: extension contract required unless source explicitly admits a static allowed-state interpretation

temporal.entry: state/trace/time semantics, horizon/fairness and exact safety/liveness statement
temporal.status: extension contract required; finite trace absence not unbounded liveness

unbounded-first-order.provider_support: not established by a finite search

unsupported: Explicit unsupported/unknown route; never guess or erase the operator.
